name: ROCKINGHAM
confidence: high for the notes; check bars 12 and 16
source: Open Hymnal Project ABC score (Hymns Ancient and Modern, 1869, 'Rockingham Old') and the score on Wikipedia's article; the opening agrees with hymnary.org's incipit.
reviewNotes: The two sources agree except in two bars, where this follows the modern form on Wikipedia: bar 12 'but' is the sharpened fah (G sharp, fe) leading to 'loss', and bar 16 'all' is a three-note run doh-ray-me. The 1869 'Rockingham Old' has G natural and 'all' on doh-me only. Check both against your book.
